programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: As we continue our search for the best innovative design in America, our judges will fill the remaining two spots left in our top ten for the year.Amongst the 6 designs up for consideration we discover digital design that’s used in Hollywood movies, IBM shows us how to design for racial equity, and we see a new kitchen measuring cup that’s so simple it’s hard to believe no one has thought of it before!

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: In this series, a panel of judges reviews architectural achievements from across America to determine which project will be named the season winner.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode, Mike travels to Aruba in the Caribbean to enjoy the Boardwalk Boutique Hotel, Adam explores an old Fire Station that has been converted into the Detroit Foundation Hotel, and Scott visits Oregon and the whimsical McMenamins Grand Lodge.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: In this episode, Mike indulges in the deep bohemian roots of Alila Ventana Big Sur in California, Architect Richard Riveire shows us around his latest project – a Viking Cruise Ship, Scott takes us to Newport, Rhode Island to explore the Hammetts Hotel, Mike explores a unique regional Massachusetts offering of The Porches Inn at MASS MoCA, and we head to Southern California to look at two hotels next to each other - Mission Pacific Hotel & The Seabird Resort.

programme.title: Leed Gold Minneapolis Lakefront Home Tour
programme.desc: Meet Melissa and Jim - they built their dream home a few years ago, but this wasn’t like any other home.Their main goal was to have a healthy home for their kids, and one that would also save on energy and environmental resources.

programme.title: Passive House Ranch Tour
programme.desc: Welcome to the Passive House Ranch!Homeowners Beate and Bern have created a state of the art modern home while preserving the structure's original character.

programme.title: Passive House LA’s First Ever!
programme.desc: Passive House is an easy to understand building standard that takes home energy efficiency to a whole new level using 5 building standards that are explained in this video.

programme.title: Why Electricity Is Better Than Natural Gas In Your Home
programme.desc: Are you still using natural gas in your home?Have you thought about the health impacts of doing so?Bruce Nilles--a Senior Fellow at the Rocky Mountain Institute--realized that his biggest carbon footprint was his own home.

programme.title: Building An Energy Efficient Home On An Existing Foundation
programme.desc: This video is a great example of how you can build a relatively affordable, urban, energy-efficient house on an existing foundation.Houses in St.Paul, Minnesota, and all over the world, have old houses on tight urban sites that need to be redeveloped.

programme.title: Metal that MELTS AT LOW TEMPERATURES
programme.desc: This alloy is made from Tin and Bismuth, contains no lead and melts at around 280 degrees Fahrenheit.I poured this molten metal directly into wood to fill in knotholes and to cover up screws and pocket holes.

programme.title: LEGO Router Template
programme.desc: Woodworking with LEGO!I have used Lego bricks as design and prototyping tools for a long time, but typically I use them for casting concrete or mold making.

programme.title: Plywood Incline Bench
programme.desc: I made a DIY workout bench that goes from flat to a 30-degree incline in just 34 seconds.This is part of my DIY plywood home gym set up and this bench is an easy woodworking project that can be made with basic power tools.

programme.title: Making SEA GLASS with a rock tumbler
programme.desc: I used rock tumblers to make sea glass. Tumbling glass in a rock tumbler allows you to make your sea glass in 3-5 days.

programme.title: Concrete Pool Lounge Chair
programme.desc: DIY concrete pool lounge formed with plywood and linoleum.For this DIY concrete pool lounge, I made reusable molds for concrete furniture out of plywood and linoleum.

programme.title: Using Dirt To Form Concrete
programme.desc: I used rammed earth to form a concrete lounge chair.I have been experimenting with rammed earth projects, but so far, just as forms for cement and sand mixtures, I have got some true rammed earth builds coming.

programme.title: This Smart Home inspires me! FULL TOUR
programme.desc: This smart home has VERY practical automations that make life way easier!

programme.title: The Smart Remote I’ve been WAITING for! Sofabaton X2
programme.desc: I FINALLY found the smart remote I've been looking for: Sofabaton X2.

programme.title: Inside a Coastal House That Feels Settled, Not New
programme.desc: What does it mean for a house to tread lightly in a coastal landscape?At Point Lonsdale, Field Office Architects shaped a home that responds first to ecology, outlook and a sense of calm drawn from its surroundings.

programme.title: In Stillness – An Architect’s Own Home Shaped by Screens and Light
programme.desc: Set beneath a canopy of eucalypts, Jan Juc Studio is an architect's own home and studio shaped by openness and restraint.Timber screens, filtered light, and coastal breezes create quiet moments where landscape, daily ritual, and stillness coexist.

programme.title: What Does an ‘Enough’ House Look Like?
programme.desc: Can an architectural home be achieved on a tight budget?At Fisherman’s Walk in Barwon Heads, this coastal family house was shaped by restraint, where clarity, efficiency and first principles guided every decision.

programme.title: Only What's Necessary with MGAO – Less, by Design
programme.desc: Is simplicity the same as minimalism?Matt Ross Goodman, Director of MGAO, reflects on an approach to simplicity defined by restraint rather than reduction.

programme.title: Simple, Not Simplistic with MRTN Architects – Less, by Design
programme.desc: What is the difference between a simple space and a simplistic one?Antony Martin, Director of MRTN Architects, reflects on the ideas that guide his work: space, light and material as the primary tools of architecture.

programme.title: 5 Australian Coastal Homes That Embrace the Landscape
programme.desc: Australia’s coastline has long shaped the way we live, offering moments of reflection and a quieter understanding of our landscape and history.Each project rethinks coastal living for contemporary life, balancing privacy and openness, durability and warmth, retreat and connection.

programme.title: Inside a Small Cabin Nestled in the Forest
programme.desc: What happens when a small cabin is designed to recede into the trees?Located within a low-lying forest in Bittern on the Mornington Peninsula, this compact retreat by Nic Morgante sits quietly beneath dense canopies, shaped as much by restraint as by the land itself.

programme.title: This Architect’s Own Home Shows What 'Less but Better' Really Means
programme.desc: Can a “less but better” approach create a richer home?In Separation Creek, along the Great Ocean Road in Victoria, MGAO designed a 90m² retreat for his family where restraint and the essentials are not limitations, but the source of its richness.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 181

programme.title: Look Forward Not Far
programme.desc: We all go through times when we’re looking ahead, and our future looks uncertain.We want clarity, but instead, God gives us the courage to move forward in faith.

programme.title: New Number Same Name
programme.desc: If you’re looking at what’s next and feeling nervous, remember this: What God has done in your life is only the foundation, not the finish line.He’s a creative God, still at work in ways you’re not expecting.

programme.title: The Prayer That Repairs
programme.desc: Don’t be so confused about the noise around you that you can’t hear the God who made you.When you’re faced with a struggle you didn’t see coming, remember that Jesus is already praying for you, and His prayer is stronger than any attack.

programme.title: Move It To The Middle
programme.desc: Stressed, insecure, and stuck — that’s how Moses felt, too.But that wasn’t the end of his story, and it’s not yours, either.It’s just the middle.There’s hope past this chapter, and it’s found by shifting your focus back to God.

programme.title: A Recipe For Resentment
programme.desc: If you’ve been feeling pulled in every direction, it might be time to pivot.God isn’t asking you to do everything — He’s asking you to stay close to Him

programme.title: The Lord Will Lighten Your Load
programme.desc: When you’ve been hurt, it can be hard to keep hoping.But God wants to lift the weight you’ve been carrying today.Learn from the life of Israel (Jacob, Jacob), how God will give you a strategy to unburden your heart and move forward.

programme.title: When God Gets Ready
programme.desc: People label, but God names.You don’t have to chase identity or earn worth, because you’ve always been called, loved, and set apart for something more.

programme.title: Don't Let The Attack Distract You
programme.desc: Right when you start to feel some positive momentum in your life, an attack comes out of nowhere.Sound familiar?Pastor Steven uses the parable of the seeds to illustrate what to do when the enemy attacks and how to persevere in your purpose.

programme.title: Don't Forget Where You Come From
programme.desc: Feeling like you don’t have enough?God has given you an inheritance, so don’t let pressure shrink your perspective or make you forget who you are.The God who brought you this far is more than capable of driving out what’s in your way.

programme.title: It's Worth The Dirt
programme.desc: Wondering if you should give up because progress feels slow?Wisdom isn’t choosing what’s easiest, it’s choosing what’s worth it.If you’re tempted to quit because it’s hard, remember: God uses pressure and patience to prepare you for something greater.

programme.title: Not Something, But Someone
programme.desc: Pastor Steven shares a simple truth that can help you endure life’s hardest trials.True security isn't the absence of trouble; it’s the presence of a Savior who promises you’ll never walk through it alone.

programme.title: Faith to Stay
programme.desc: When we’re going through a season that’s uncomfortable or uncertain, we often look for a way out.But Jesus demonstrates another way that leads to lasting transformation and fulfillment if we have the faith to follow His example.

programme.title: Bent Knees Break Chains
programme.desc: While the chain of events isn't always your choice, your next decision still is.In “Bent Knees Break Chains,” we learn that our future isn’t defined by what happens to us, but is influenced by our choices instead.

programme.title: God's Up To Something Upstream
programme.desc: In “God’s Up To Something Upstream!,” Pastor Steven reminds us that wherever we have a problem, God already has a plan.

programme.title: When God Gives A Thought To You
programme.desc: We live in a world that values things more than thoughts, so when God speaks to us, we don’t always value it like we should.In this message, learn some of the ways God speaks, when to ask for it, and how to recognize it when He does.
